title: Our Future Health — Imputed genotype data — Variant summary statistics — warning checks
description: Non-blocking checks for the variant_summary_statistics table, from plausibility ranges the source does not state (D127). A finding is a warning for analysts and data providers: it never rejects a row and never changes data. Run tools/warn.py; the main schema and tools/validate.py are unaffected.

allOf.$comment: Warning G01: AF is expected to be between 0 and 1 (it is an allele frequency); a value outside that range may point to a data problem.
Warning G02: PROP_TYPED is expected to be between 0 and 1 (it is a proportion of groups); a value outside that range may point to a data problem.
Warning G03: DR2 is expected to be at least 0 (an r-squared is not negative); a value outside that range may point to a data problem.
